summary: Busy Witton Road kerb, few parked cars, houses at the verge, No Stopping signs.
reasons: Collector road, no parking convention here
No Stopping Any Time signs on this stretch
Homes sit right behind this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the south kerb within about 10-15 m. Not secluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow verge with driveways and trees; no clear pull-off beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road to a junction; a vehicle near the 50 m mark looks stopped, not a parking pattern.
drivers.convention: No marked parking lane; signed No Stopping Any Time.

flags: Low-lying: about 7 m elevation, creek 103 m away
sun_shade: Street and garden trees shade parts of the kerb; open to the sun elsewhere.
